seurat_transfer.interpretation_boundary: Keep scores, pruned labels, reference coverage and unknown identities separate. A score is not a calibrated label probability.

hdwgcna_network.interpretation_boundary: Keep actual soft powers, module membership, eigengenes and TOM. Do not recluster TOM with an unrelated Euclidean distance or treat metacells as donors.

palantir_trajectory.interpretation_boundary: Pseudotime and fate probabilities retain roots/partitions and original representation. They are not physical time or experimentally established lineage.

monocle3_trajectory.interpretation_boundary: Pseudotime and fate probabilities retain roots/partitions and original representation. They are not physical time or experimentally established lineage.

scgen_predict.interpretation_boundary: Keep observed data, predicted responses and reference reconstructions distinct. Preserve target scenarios and exact producer validation scope; no count/DE/causal substitution.

scvidr_predict.interpretation_boundary: Keep observed data, predicted responses and reference reconstructions distinct. Preserve target scenarios and exact producer validation scope; no count/DE/causal substitution.

causcell_counterfactual_fit.interpretation_boundary: Keep observed data, predicted responses and reference reconstructions distinct. Preserve target scenarios and exact producer validation scope; no count/DE/causal substitution.

diablo_fit.interpretation_boundary: DIABLO fit is not independent validation; SNF similarity is not a causal network; CellCap decoder projections are model weights, not measured gene effects.

snf_fusion.interpretation_boundary: DIABLO fit is not independent validation; SNF similarity is not a causal network; CellCap decoder projections are model weights, not measured gene effects.

cellcap_programs.interpretation_boundary: DIABLO fit is not independent validation; SNF similarity is not a causal network; CellCap decoder projections are model weights, not measured gene effects.

msstats_compare.interpretation_boundary: Use the supplied effect scale, uncertainty and tested universe. Spatial association without a supplied effect cannot be drawn as a volcano. Retain missing populations and donor/section units.

muscat_pseudobulk.interpretation_boundary: Use the supplied effect scale, uncertainty and tested universe. Spatial association without a supplied effect cannot be drawn as a volcano. Retain missing populations and donor/section units.

spark_spatial.interpretation_boundary: Use the supplied effect scale, uncertainty and tested universe. Spatial association without a supplied effect cannot be drawn as a volcano. Retain missing populations and donor/section units.

mixscape_classify.interpretation_boundary: Retain NP/unknown classes and within-unit strata. Classification fractions are not validated KO efficacy or donor-level differential abundance.

cellot_predict.interpretation_boundary: Author feature-space transport is not necessarily gene expression; the legacy predicted_expression role is not permission to relabel it.

destvi_deconvolution.interpretation_boundary: Only get_proportions output is a normalized proportion. Gamma is latent state; spots are not biological replicates.

cell2location_reference.interpretation_boundary: Reference signatures and posterior uncertainty retain their original scale and reference design.

cell2location_map.interpretation_boundary: Unnormalized estimated abundance is not a proportion or exact measured count. Q05/Q95 is a 90% posterior credible interval when used as endpoints.

progeny_activity.interpretation_boundary: PROGENy footprints and drug2cell target-expression scores retain resource/version/coverage. They are not GSVA enrichment P-values, binding affinity or drug potency.

drug2cell_score.interpretation_boundary: PROGENy footprints and drug2cell target-expression scores retain resource/version/coverage. They are not GSVA enrichment P-values, binding affinity or drug potency.

cellphonedb_per_unit.interpretation_boundary: Keep actual database interaction IDs, means and within-stratum permutation P-values. No invented between-donor contrast or evidence of physical binding.

paste_pairwise.interpretation_boundary: Transport mass and source/target axes must remain exact. OT coupling is not an experimentally paired cell correspondence; do not renormalize or discard weak entries for aesthetics.

squidpy_section_statistics.interpretation_boundary: Keep section-specific graph/distance units, Moran statistics, neighborhood counts/Z-scores and cooccurrence distinct. Preserve undefined values.

vep_offline.interpretation_boundary: Literal variant/allele/reference identity and consequence terms are required; annotated consequence alone is not measured function or clinical pathogenicity.

ldsc_h2.interpretation_boundary: Retain estimate scale, supplied uncertainty, LD/allele QC and HEIDI missing states. Do not clip negative heritability or call HEIDI non-rejection proof of causality.

smr_heidi.interpretation_boundary: Retain estimate scale, supplied uncertainty, LD/allele QC and HEIDI missing states. Do not clip negative heritability or call HEIDI non-rejection proof of causality.

seurat_to_anndata.interpretation_boundary: Exact format exchange preserves observed layers and stored geometry; identity round-trip is not new analysis or scientific validation.

cinemaot_effects.interpretation_boundary: Actual differences on the producer log1p scale are not log2 fold changes. Matching is computational, not experimental pairing or causal proof.

systema_evaluate.interpretation_boundary: Centroid accuracy is a rank fraction with the native other-centroid denominator, not binary nearest-centroid accuracy. Correlation undefinedness and top-gene selection remain explicit.

xcms_preprocess.interpretation_boundary: Keep detected and filled peaks distinct, missingness, QC/blank roles, retention-time seconds and m/z. Feature intensity is not compound identification or RNA counts.

baysor_segment.interpretation_boundary: Keep noise assignments (cell 0), transcript IDs, coordinate units and polygon provenance. Segmentation labels are not cell-type annotations.

nestedcv_glmnet.interpretation_boundary: Use exact outer-fold units, task/class order and event labels; no invented five-fold or external-validation claim and no full-data-fit performance substitution.

diffdock_pose.interpretation_boundary: Pose confidence is not affinity; generated molecules keep fragments/sanitization failures; generated backbones do not establish sequence, binding or function.

diffsbdd_generate.interpretation_boundary: Pose confidence is not affinity; generated molecules keep fragments/sanitization failures; generated backbones do not establish sequence, binding or function.

rfdiffusion_backbone.interpretation_boundary: Pose confidence is not affinity; generated molecules keep fragments/sanitization failures; generated backbones do not establish sequence, binding or function.

mace_singlepoint.interpretation_boundary: Single-point energy (eV) and force (eV/angstrom) retain model/head/elements. These are not electrostatic potential, binding energy or free energy.

igv_scoped_report.interpretation_boundary: Review the actual offline genome browser. Region read count is not allele balance/support; file generation is not browser acceptance.

batchie_posterior.interpretation_boundary: Posterior viability mean and Q05/Q95 form a 90% credible interval for conditional mean. MCMC draws are not biological samples and this is not an observational prediction interval.

prescient_trajectories.interpretation_boundary: Keep checkpoint representation, actual initial-cell IDs, simulation replicate and dt. Learned potential is not thermodynamic free energy; simulations are not biological replicates.

proteintalks_predict.interpretation_boundary: Native ticks 1/2/3 map to trained labels 6/24/48 h. Show discrete predictions; no invented physical-hour continuous integration or continuous synergy scale.

native_unit_profile_handoff.interpretation_boundary: Within-unit means preserve every scenario, source-cell membership and eligibility HOLD. Averaging creates no new replicate and cannot upgrade model validation.

magpie_coregister.interpretation_boundary: No top-level upstream license located in the reviewed tree; use only an owned checkout with actual permitted-use evidence. No author code is redistributed.

diann_quantify.interpretation_boundary: Academia limited non-profit edition only; Enterprise excluded. Native binary and its actual license must already be provisioned by owner.

sirius_formulas.interpretation_boundary: Offline molecular-formula/fragmentation-tree route only; no fingerprint/structure prediction service is called.

csi_result_import.interpretation_boundary: Actual author-result import implemented. Fresh proprietary online prediction remains outside current authorization; no private spectra upload, no claim of an offline CSI algorithm.

gnps_offline_network.interpretation_boundary: Actual original legacy Python spectral alignment plus explicit mutual-top-K. This is not the complete GNPS2 FBMN workflow or a structure identification method; no upload.

dockovalent.interpretation_boundary: Owner-provisioned licensed DOCKovalent 3.7 plus actual prepared DB2/grids. Not DOCK 3.8 or ordinary Vina. No licensed engine bundled.

prnet_predict.interpretation_boundary: Native Gaussian PGM inference with actual fixed drug/dose embeddings; no new training, no fabricated chemical embedding or independent-validation claim.

scdiffusion_generate.interpretation_boundary: EperLuo/scDiffusion latent DDPM/DDIM plus strict autoencoder decode; empty, one- or two-classifier guidance with exact class and noise-schedule binding. Generated class-conditioned expression is not a perturbation effect; gradient interpolation from a real starting cell is a separate unimplemented scope.

squidiff_predict.interpretation_boundary: Native semantic encoder and DDIM with training-only frozen latent direction. Upstream license file contains unresolved merge markers; actual owned-use review required. No fake get_diffused_data noise helper.

cellnavi_drivers.interpretation_boundary: Native finite-tuned driver logits/ranks using exact vocabulary, graph and actual training class prefix. Not expression prediction, calibrated probability or causal driver confirmation.

stack_incontext.interpretation_boundary: Native StateICL in-context count prediction. Code and model/output licenses differ; no full-object pickle, missing-gene zero padding or context/target-unit leakage.

morphdiff_gene2image.interpretation_boundary: Correct biomap-research/MorphDiff source, separate five-channel gene-to-image and image-to-image. The pinned native DDIM sampler forces CUDA; an existing server GPU is required, CPU is rejected. Not bowang-lab/MorphoDiff; generated morphology is not measured microscopy.

morphdiff_image2image.interpretation_boundary: Correct biomap-research/MorphDiff source, separate five-channel gene-to-image and image-to-image. The pinned native DDIM sampler forces CUDA; an existing server GPU is required, CPU is rejected. Not bowang-lab/MorphoDiff; generated morphology is not measured microscopy.

omics71.interpretation_boundary: Select the exact reviewed analysis ID and result role; do not turn probabilities, ranks, expression predictions or associations into different quantities.

global_rules: Use exact selected output paths when a role repeats. Never choose the last file implicitly.
Completed receipt, current expected source hashes, selected bytes and returned QC must bind before native result rendering.
Upstream H5AD/RDS/model objects require a frozen bounded display export on the server. Do not fit an embedding or unpickle models locally.
Select complementary supplied channels; missing channels remain unavailable, not zero or fabricated placeholder panels.
